character_desc: A farm boy who answers every request with 'As you wish', sails away to seek his fortune, and returns as the mysterious Man in Black.
actor_facts: He did almost every second of the great sword duel himself, after months of fencing practice.
He broke his toe during filming and hid it from the director so he would not be sent home.
He wrote a whole book about making this movie. It is called As You Wish, of course.

character_desc: The most beautiful woman in the world, ordered to marry a prince she does not love. Brave enough to leap into eel waters and walk into the Fire Swamp.
actor_facts: This was her first big movie. She was 20 years old.
She later played Antiope, the warrior general who trains Wonder Woman.
Between takes, Andre the Giant kept her warm with one enormous hand on her head.

character_desc: A Spanish swordsman on a lifelong quest to find the six-fingered man who killed his father. Kind, funny, and the best fencer in the land. Except maybe one.
actor_facts: He says Inigo is his favorite role he has ever played.
He learned to fence right-handed AND left-handed for the duel.
He is also a famous Broadway singer with a huge voice.

character_desc: A gentle giant who loves rhymes and hates fighting dirty. Being the biggest and the strongest is just his job.
actor_facts: He was a world-famous wrestler, billed at 7-foot-4 and over 500 pounds.
The author wrote Fezzik with Andre in mind years before the movie was made.
Cast members say he was the kindest person on the whole set.
